backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two gameplay-visual update features and associated files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains autogenerated short summaries for various frontend files including UI, game logic, and PWA infrastructure.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color variables, dark mode overrides, and global background/foreground styling.
frontend/index.html: PWA entry HTML defining metadata, icons, manifest link, and mounting root for the React app.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest specifying app branding, icons, display settings, categories, and shortcuts for Saan Rewards.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone styled offline fallback page with a retry button, status indicator, and auto-reload when back online.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing network-first navigation handling, offline fallback, icon caching, and cache cleanup.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component with header, Saan Rewards home screen, About dialog, and service worker registration.
frontend/src/components/AboutHelp.tsx: Help/about component explaining the app purpose, website link, installation steps, and basic usage instructions.
frontend/src/components/OnlineRequiredBl: Fullscreen overlay that informs the user they are offline and provides a retry button.
frontend/src/components/SaanRewardsHomeS: UI screen offering quick access, install options, and sharing features for the Saan Rewards website.
Empty placeholder file with no implemented content.
Wrapper around dialog content providing standardized styling, transitions, and layout.
frontend/src/game/controls/TouchControls: Mobile touch control buttons that update left, right, and brake game control states using pointer events.
frontend/src/game/controls/useGameContro: Centralized control state with hooks and keyboard listeners to manage left, right, and brake inputs.
frontend/src/game/scene/PlayerCarModel.t: React Three Fiber component rendering a custom race-car model using meshes and textures.
Main 3D scene handling player movement, obstacle spawning, roadside elements, scoring, and collisions.
frontend/src/game/TrafficJamGame.tsx: Top-level game component managing game state, score, scene resets, HUD, and online blocking.
frontend/src/game/ui/CanvasErrorBoundary: Error boundary that catches rendering errors in the 3D canvas and shows a retry fallback UI.
frontend/src/game/ui/GameHud.tsx: UI component showing the current score and a game‑over overlay with restart button.
frontend/src/game/ui/SceneRenderFallback: Fallback UI card shown when the 3D scene fails to render, offering retry.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, exposing identity state and login/clear actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnlineStatus.ts: Hook that tracks online/offline browser status and provides a manual recheck.
frontend/src/hooks/usePwaInstall.ts: Hook managing PWA install prompts, installability detection, and installation flow state.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom theme variables for the racing game UI, plus global layout and component classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, query client, and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/utils/shareUrl.ts: Utility that returns the current URL without hash fragments to avoid sharing sensitive tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme colors, radii, animations, and plugins for the project.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current scope and constraints for a single‑vehicle browser racing game and lists architectural notes, known issues, and existing features. Serves as the master state file guiding compliance, UX, and build requirements.
